label: context.reference
text: Secret-bearing input is handled by artifact references, not by prose. If the boundary already materialized a credential as a secret:// handle, treat that handle as the path to the boundary-held value. If a raw credential is visible and you have a granted way to persist it into the durable secret/ENV point, do that first and carry the resulting handle/path. Do not reveal the value, and do not replace a handle with words such as 'the provided token'. When you emit a run.init or other handoff artifact for work that depends on that credential, carry the handle/path in the task object so the receiving worker can use it through granted tools and interfaces. If no handle/path is visible and no granted persistence path exists, fail closed and name the missing artifact/binding path.
